informal_statement: The charged-lepton mass ratios may be derivable from rooted ZFA closure classes through the existing Koide three-phase form. This record freezes the selection and comparison protocol before any target mass is read.

approximation_or_regime.name: Koide three-phase leading form
approximation_or_regime.description: m_i = M (1 + sqrt(2) cos(delta + 2*pi*i/3))^2 with Q = 2/3 fixed by the existing formal Koide result; M is the overall scale and delta is the single dimensionless input.
approximation_or_regime.validity_limits: Pole-mass charged leptons only. No running-mass, quark, neutrino or higher-order correction is in scope. The phase delta has no derivation yet.

formal_statement.statement_scope: The existing Lean results fix the generation count, the Koide invariant and the electron axis/fold anchor. None of them fixes the lepton mass ratios or the Koide phase.

formal_object.type: finite rooted twist histories, closure classes and the Koide three-phase functional

dependencies.audit_baseline: Reviewed 375-entry baseline after #222; this protocol adds no Lean anchors and no new theorem claims.
dependencies.qlf_bridge_axioms: No new bridge axiom. The Koide form, the overall scale and the missing phase derivation are stated explicitly as inputs/open obligations.

inputs.name: Koide three-phase functional
inputs.source: existing Koide form; the phase delta is not derived

inputs.name: electron mass scale
inputs.value: M fixed after the ratio functional is frozen
inputs.source: charged-lepton scale only; not used to select a ratio or delta

interpretation.map: Rooted ZFA closure classes -> Koide three-phase mass functional -> ordered charged-lepton ratios.
interpretation.formal_status: The generation count, Koide Q = 2/3 and the electron anchor are formal. The closure-class-to-delta map is not formalized and the conservative return is not constructed.
interpretation.noncircularity_test: No muon or tau mass may enter the selection, the functional choice or the derivation of delta. The target is read only after the prediction is committed.

strange_loop.name: unlabeled lepton closure classes -> Koide three-phase functional -> ordered mass ratios -> comparator
levels: rooted ZFA closure classes without lepton labels
strange_loop.return_level: closure-class invariants recovered from the mass assignment
strange_loop.conservative_return: No return is constructed. The protocol requires the mass assignment to recover axis content, first-return depth, fold sign, rooted B and orbit multiplicity; until then it is not a QLF derivation.
strange_loop.noncircularity_witness: The masses m_mu and m_tau are excluded from construction inputs. The electron fixes only the overall scale after the dimensionless prediction is frozen.
strange_loop.first_order_note: Existing formal inputs (generation count, Koide Q and electron anchor) are F, but the mass map itself has no first-order F or N result yet. This is a pre-registration, not a derivation.
strange_loop.defeater: A delta selected from the target masses; an undeclared free parameter; a topology ladder whose uniqueness depends on an unstated axis filter; or a return map that cannot recover the closure invariants.

proof_obligation.domain: rooted ZFA closure classes with frozen axis, depth, fold and B conditions
proof_obligation.codomain: ordered charged-lepton mass ratios in the Koide three-phase form
proof_obligation.forward_map: closure class -> Koide three-phase functional with a closure-derived delta
proof_obligation.return_map: mass assignment -> recovered closure invariants (axis content, depth, fold, B, multiplicity)
proof_obligation.imported_axioms: Koide three-phase form; overall scale M; derivation of delta absent; pole-mass regime
proof_obligation.falsifier: Frozen ratios miss the comparator, or delta is chosen after target access, or the return cannot recover the closure invariants.

observable.uncertainties: not evaluated before the frozen prediction is committed

measurement_protocol.design: Stage A enumerates unlabeled rooted closure classes with the frozen rules. Stage B derives delta from closure counts or records failure. Stage C reads PDG pole masses only after the ratio prediction is frozen. Stage D records pass, miss or invalid.
measurement_protocol.failure_condition: No closure-count derivation of delta, more than the declared free inputs, a post-hoc correction, or an undeclared axis filter.

reported_agreement.comparator: PDG charged-lepton pole masses and Koide Q, read only after the prediction is frozen

evidence.F: Existing formal inputs only: generation count, Koide Q = 2/3, electron cycle/axis/fold anchor. No formal mass map.
evidence.N: None. No frozen mass-ratio prediction has been evaluated.
evidence.E: None. No empirical evidence is claimed.
evidence.reviewer: self-reviewed pre-registration; no collaborator or independent receipt

defeaters.formal: The formal inputs do not determine delta, or the proposed map uses more than the declared degrees of freedom.
defeaters.interpretation: The closure-class axis/depth labels do not correspond to lepton generations without the target masses.
defeaters.numerical: The frozen ratios miss the comparator outside the declared uncertainty.
defeaters.empirical: A prospective or independent test contradicts the frozen prediction.
defeaters.conceptual: The Koide phase is a coordinate artifact, or the conservative return is impossible.

G0.reason: Scope and noncircularity rules are frozen in Lepton_Mass_Ratio_Protocol.md.

G1.reason: No mass-functional theorem or closure-class-to-delta derivation exists.

G2.reason: No formal map from closure classes to the mass functional has been proved.

G3.reason: No operational bridge or conservative return; the protocol is B-OPEN.

G4.reason: No frozen numerical prediction has been evaluated.

G5.reason: No prospective or independent comparator has been run.

G6.reason: No receipt; this is a self-reviewed draft protocol.

reviewer_independence.original_lean_kernel: project CI for the existing formal inputs; no new Lean in this record

provenance.status: pre-registration draft; no result, no evidence promotion
